**Subject:** Reading Club Meeting on August 7 in Room 2

**Dear Readers,**

We are excited to announce our upcoming Reading Club meeting on August 7, 2023, in Room 2. This is an excellent opportunity for you to engage with a diverse range of literary works and discuss them with fellow enthusiasts.

**Invitation to Newcomers:** We welcome everyone to join us. If you are new to our club, please bring a poem or short piece you have written to share with the group. This will provide us with a rich source of material to discuss and foster a deeper understanding of poetry and literature.

**Join us on August 7 at 2 PM to explore the world of poetry and literature together!**

**Remember:** If you have any questions or need further information, feel free to reach out to us.

**Best regards,**
[Your Name]  
Founder of Reading Club
